data.headline: TSMC price target lowered to NT$1,145 from NT$1,190 at Goldman Sachs
data.summary: Goldman Sachs lowered the firm’s price target on TSMC (TSM) to NT$1,145 from NT$1,190 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares as part of a broader research note citing “heightened” appreciation of Taiwan currency vs. US Dollar.
